semantic_plan.subtask: Carry the upright moka pot above the burner, lower it onto the coil, release its handle, and withdraw.

steps.intent: Raise the pot farther before lateral transport to clear the stove edge
Center the pot body above the burner and lower its base onto the support surface, accounting for the handle's asymmetric observed bounds
Release the moka pot handle at the burner support height
Withdraw the open fingers vertically from the handle for actual placement review
